title: How do I configure SSO login with OIDC?
body: We want users to sign in with our identity provider instead of local accounts. Which settings does Orbit need for OIDC authentication, and why do I get a 401 after the redirect?
author: asker

answers.body:
Enable the OIDC provider in `orbit.yaml`:

```yaml
auth:
  oidc:
    issuer: https://login.example.internal/realms/corp
    clientId: orbit
    redirectUri: https://orbit.example.internal/callback
```

The 401 after redirect usually means `redirectUri` does not exactly match what is registered at the provider.
answers.author: li

answers.body: Map the `roles` claim to Orbit roles, otherwise every user lands with no permissions after a successful login.
answers.author: sam
